parse.unterminated-quote: Position {position}: this quote is never closed.

picker.hint: A tick means the filter includes that tag. Arrow keys move, right and left open and close a branch, space ticks.
picker.noMatches: No tag or label matches the search.
picker.noChange: Tick tags to add them, untick to remove them.

preview.noSearchHits: No matched item fits the search.
preview.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, id or tag…

compose.title: Run title
compose.countChanged: The catalog changed since the preview: {count} planned, {expected} were shown.

blocked.error: The preview is out of date — fix the error first.

compose.reloadCatalogHint: Read the test corpus again, to pick up tests that were added or changed
compose.linkWithoutExclusions: More than {max} items are unticked — the link carries the filter only.
compose.unreadableLink: The filter in this link could not be read, so the builder starts empty.

pinned.one: Limited to the {count} item of run
pinned.other: Limited to the {count} items of run

landing.title: Nothing selected yet

runner.label: Runner
runner.none: No runner is configured on this server. A selection can still be exported.

problem.choice: Choose one of the listed values.

labels.label: Labels
labels.hint: Labels group runs — suite=nightly — and can be filtered by in the runs list.

export.title: Export for an external executor

introCompose.one: This composes a run from the {count} selected item and hands its document out.
introCompose.other: This composes a run from the {count} selected items and hands its document out.

introRun.one: This hands out the document of “{title}” ({count} item) once more.
introRun.other: This hands out the document of “{title}” ({count} items) once more.

export.explain: Nothing is executed here. The run waits for results that somebody else produces from the document and sends back.
export.doneTitle: Exported — the run is waiting for results
export.downloadHint: Use this file exactly as downloaded: results are matched to the run by its checksum.
export.tokenOnce: This token is shown only once. Whoever sends the results needs it.
export.noToken: This server accepts results without a token.
export.pushHint: Post the result files to the run, for example:

runs.title: Runs
runs.label: Label
runs.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed.

run.title: Run
run.notFound: This run does not exist (any more).
run.cancelExplain: Items that have not started are not run. What already finished keeps its result.
run.cancelForce: Close it now, without waiting for the runner to stop
run.cancelRequested: Cancellation was requested — waiting for the runner to stop.
run.finalizeTitle: Close this run as it stands?
run.finalizeExplain: Results that have not arrived are given up: items nobody reported count as missing.
run.deleteExplain: “{title}” is deleted with its results and stored files. This cannot be undone.
run.refreshFailed: The run could not be refreshed.
run.staleHint: The server stopped while this run was executing. What had finished is kept; run it again to complete it.
run.awaitingHint: This run waits for results from outside. They arrive by upload or through the inbox.
run.composedHint: This run is composed but was never dispatched.
run.artifactNoLink: This file is outside the server's artifact directory and cannot be opened from here.
run.noVerdictsYet: No results yet — they appear here as items finish.

selection.title: Selection
selection.specHint: The stored document, without any token.

run.rotateExplain: The current token stops working at once. Whoever sends the results needs the new one.

explainAll.one: Runs the {count} item of “{title}” again, as a new dispatch of the same run.
explainAll.other: Runs all {count} items of “{title}” again, as a new dispatch of the same run.

explainFailed.one: Composes a new run from the {count} item that did not pass in “{title}”.
explainFailed.other: Composes a new run from the {count} items that did not pass in “{title}”.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.hint: Results that arrived and could not be matched to a run wait here. Nothing is attached automatically.
inbox.empty: The inbox is empty — every delivery found its run.
inbox.attachExplain: The delivered results are recorded for the run you name.
inbox.promoteTitle: Make a run of this delivery
inbox.promoteExplain: A new run is created from the delivered results.
inbox.formatHint: Only needed when the delivery does not say which format its results are in.
inbox.discardExplain: The delivered results are deleted. This cannot be undone.

promoted.one: A run was created from {count} result.
promoted.other: A run was created from {count} results.

reason.unsolicited: No run was waiting for it
reason.unknown-run: Names a run that does not exist
reason.unknown-dispatch: Names a dispatch that does not exist
reason.sha-mismatch: Belongs to a different run document
reason.marker-conflict: Names a different run than it was sent to
